Note: slides 2-4 use assertion titles, so guesses that resemble titles come from reading the pixels, not from the plan.

summary: The numbers are right and traceable (all 30 chart values and the 8→12→14→13 trace match data.json and an independent recomputation), and slide 3's fixed-coordinate grid is a good teaching form. The biggest lever: on a self-read deck for beginners, slide 3 never shows why the search goes right or left — the comparison with the middle is computed in the build script but left to the notes — so the worked example shows what happens, not how to do it. One major and several minors mean revise; the original gate also still lacks a recorded critic and blind_read for this SHA.
strengths: Every number on the slides traces to executed traces (data.json, object-proof.json); no invented results.
Slide 3: four rows on one 15-column coordinate system make the shrinking range visible without animation.
Semantic colours stay fixed deck-wide (blue=linear, purple=binary, brown=13).
Slide 4 is an editable native chart of all 15 targets and does not hide the targets where linear wins.
Slide 5 separates what was measured from what was not (seconds, sort cost) and warns against reading fewer comparisons as 'N times faster'.
Clean Japanese typesetting: no clipping, overlap or tofu; text ≥13pt with ≥4.5:1 contrast.

findings.issue: Promise 'objection: 中央を調べた後どちらへ進むか分からない' and audience_brief 'needs: 現在の範囲、中央の値、13との大小' — the page shows ranges and middles but no comparison 13>8 / 13>12 / 13<14 / 13=13 and no reason the other half can be discarded.
findings.why: Beginners reading alone cannot reproduce the step; the slide shows the result of binary search, not the method, which is the deck's learning goal.
findings.fix: Next to each row add its decision at 24pt, e.g. '13 > 8 → 右半分', '13 > 12 → 右半分', '13 < 14 → 左', '13 = 13 → 発見', and one line under the grid: '昇順なので、13より小さい側には13がない'.

findings.issue: The chart shows linear beating binary for targets 1-3, but the page only says 最大4回; the counterexample lives only in the notes.
findings.why: A self-reader may conclude binary is always fewer comparisons — the misconception the rejected arc was built around.
findings.fix: Add one 24pt line beside the chart: '目的値1〜3は線形の方が少ない。比べているのは最大回数。'

findings.issue: Promise 'purpose_section_terms objectives: 15個の数字から' — slide 1 states a task ('15個の数字から「13」を見つける。'), not what the learner will be able to do.
findings.why: The teaching overlay weights stated objectives; the reader is not told what to watch for.
findings.fix: Add under the task: 'この5枚で：二分探索が次に調べる値を自分で選べるようになる'.

findings.issue: Sortedness is called 並べておく (s1 title), 整列した (s1 body), 昇順 (s3 footer/s5), 並べ替え (s5) without saying they refer to the same thing.
findings.why: Beginners may read them as different concepts.
findings.fix: Define once on slide 1 ('昇順＝小さい順に並んでいること') and use 昇順 in body text.

findings.issue: '並んでいないデータにも使える。' is a second claim the page does not show.
findings.why: Splits the page's message; the contrast belongs with slide 5's precondition.
findings.fix: Move the line to slide 5 as the contrast to 昇順が前提, or show a small unsorted row.

findings.issue: Same kicker, same short title rule under only the first ~2 glyphs, and same condition footer on all 5 pages; the rule reads as an underline of 並べ/先頭/真ん中/15個/使え.
findings.why: Reads as stamped template chrome and adds an emphasis the copy does not intend (original Step 5 'Titles' self-check).
findings.fix: Drop the short rule (or use a full-width hairline/left bar), vary the kicker per page (線形探索 / 二分探索 / 全15通り / まとめ), keep the condition footer on slide 1 and slide 4 only.

findings.issue: 13回 vs 4回 are bare numbers; the strip only marks 13.
findings.why: The hook asserts a difference it does not show.
findings.fix: Under the strip draw two marker rows: blue dots under 1-13, purple dots under 8, 12, 14, 13.

findings.issue: Legend '紫：中央　茶枠：目的値13' omits filled brown (発見) and white empty cells (対象外); digits are light weight while slides 1-2 use bold.
findings.fix: Legend: '紫：中央　淡紫：残る範囲　白：除外　茶：目的値13'; use bold digits for consistency.

findings.issue: '13回／比較した回数' floats right, aligned to neither the arrow row nor the body; the 13pt legend sits ~400px below the strip it keys.
findings.why: Weakens the count-to-trace link; key read far from its subject.
findings.fix: Put the legend directly under the strip; align '13回' to the arrow-sequence baseline.

findings.issue: y-axis title '比較回数（回）' floats above the plot beside the legend; '探す値 →' is detached at lower right.
findings.why: Axis labels not anchored to their axes.
findings.fix: Attach the axis titles to their axes (rotated y title left of ticks; x title centred under ticks).

findings.issue: Promise 'takeaway: 二分探索には昇順が必要で、比較回数の減少から実時間の速さは判断できない' — title is an instruction ('使える条件も、いっしょに覚える'); text-only page with a dead band between body and closing line.
findings.why: The recap's assertion sits at the bottom instead of the title.
findings.fix: Title: '比較が少ない≠速い。二分探索は昇順が前提'; close the gap or add a small sorted-vs-unsorted contrast.
